task.K3: 同小朋友一齊刷牙，一邊刷一邊數牙齒：up-down、up-down，數到 20 就叫停。
task.P1: 玩「搵污糟」遊戲：叫小朋友用英文講出邊隻牙仲有 food bits，然後一齊刷乾淨。
task.P2: 扮牙醫同病人，用英文形容 minty foam、stubborn spots、wiggly tooth，鼓勵小朋友多啲描述細節。

dialogue.en: Time to brush your teeth!
dialogue.zh: 刷牙喇！

dialogue.en: Okay, Mama. Here is my toothbrush.
dialogue.zh: 好呀媽咪，呢個係我嘅牙刷。

dialogue.en: Let me put a little toothpaste on it.
dialogue.zh: 我幫你唧少少牙膏。

dialogue.en: Now I brush up and down!
dialogue.zh: 我而家上下刷啦！

dialogue.en: Good girl! Brush the back teeth too.
dialogue.zh: 乖女！後面啲牙都要刷埋。

dialogue.en: Can I have some water now?
dialogue.zh: 我可以飲啲水未呀？

dialogue.en: Yes, take your cup and spit it out.
dialogue.zh: 得喇，攞個杯漱口，然後吐出嚟。

dialogue.en: Look, my teeth are so clean!
dialogue.zh: 你睇，我啲牙好乾淨呀！

dialogue.en: Come on, sweetie, it's time to brush before bed.
dialogue.zh: 乖女，瞓覺前刷牙喇。

dialogue.en: Do I really have to? I did it this morning.
dialogue.zh: 真係要咩？我朝早先刷咗喎。

dialogue.en: Yes, we brush morning and night to chase the germs away.
dialogue.zh: 係呀，朝早同夜晚都要刷，先趕得走啲細菌。

dialogue.en: Okay. Can I put the toothpaste on myself?
dialogue.zh: 好啦。我可以自己唧牙膏呀？

dialogue.en: Sure, just a pea-sized bit is enough.
dialogue.zh: 得呀，唧一粒青豆咁多就夠喇。

dialogue.en: Look at all the bubbles in my mouth!
dialogue.zh: 你睇我把口好多泡泡呀！

dialogue.en: Be gentle on your gums, don't push too hard.
dialogue.zh: 刷牙肉輕力啲，唔好撳咁大力。

dialogue.en: Like this? It tickles a little.
dialogue.zh: 係咪咁樣呀？有啲痕痕哋。

dialogue.en: Perfect. Now rinse and spit into the sink.
dialogue.zh: 好正！而家漱口再吐落洗手盆。

dialogue.en: My mouth feels so fresh now!
dialogue.zh: 我把口而家好清新呀！

dialogue.en: Wonderful. Wipe your face with the towel.
dialogue.zh: 好叻！用毛巾抹乾個面啦。

dialogue.en: All done! Good night, Mama.
dialogue.zh: 搞掂喇！晚安媽咪。

dialogue.en: Alright, poppet, let's give those pearly whites a good scrub.
dialogue.zh: 嚟啦寶貝，好好刷乾淨你啲白雪雪嘅牙仔。

dialogue.en: Ugh, do we have to? I'm so sleepy already.
dialogue.zh: 唉，一定要刷咩？我眼瞓到不得了喇。

dialogue.en: Just two minutes, and I'll squeeze on a tiny minty dot for you.
dialogue.zh: 得兩分鐘啫，我幫你唧一粒薄荷味嘅牙膏。

dialogue.en: It smells like candy! Can I start with the front ones?
dialogue.zh: 好似糖咁香呀！我可以由前面啲牙開始刷呀？

dialogue.en: Go for it — little circles, not straight lines, that gets the plaque off.
dialogue.zh: 刷啦——刷圈圈，唔好一橫一橫咁刷，先刷得走牙菌膜。

dialogue.en: My mouth is all foamy now, like a bubble bath!
dialogue.zh: 我把口而家全部泡泡，好似浸泡泡浴咁！

dialogue.en: Ha! Now hunt down those stubborn spots hiding at the back.
dialogue.zh: 哈！而家搵下匿埋喺後面嗰啲頑固污漬。

dialogue.en: Found one! There's a bit of dinner still stuck back there.
dialogue.zh: 搵到喇！後面仲黐住少少晚飯嘅嘢。

dialogue.en: Good eye. Brush gently so you don't hurt your gums.
dialogue.zh: 眼利喎。輕輕哋刷，咪整痛牙肉。

dialogue.en: Mama, one of my bottom teeth wiggles when I touch it.
dialogue.zh: 媽咪，我下面有隻牙一掂就郁嚟郁去喎。

dialogue.en: That's a wobbly tooth — it's ready to fall out soon, how exciting!
dialogue.zh: 嗰隻係鬆咗嘅牙——就嚟甩喇，好興奮呀！

dialogue.en: Really? Will the tooth fairy come?
dialogue.zh: 真㗎？牙仙子會嚟㗎？

dialogue.en: She just might. Now swish some water and spit it out.
dialogue.zh: 好有可能㗎。而家含啖水漱下口再吐出嚟。

dialogue.en: Swish, swish… and spit! My teeth sparkle now.
dialogue.zh: 漱下、漱下……吐！我啲牙而家閃令令呀。

dialogue.en: Beautiful — no cavities for you. Let me smell that fresh breath.
dialogue.zh: 靚仔——你冇蛀牙。等我聞下你把口幾咁清新。

dialogue.en: Minty fresh, all the way to the moon! Good night, Mama.
dialogue.zh: 薄荷咁清新，一路清到上月球！晚安媽咪。

dialogue.en: Mama, I don't want to brush tonight.
dialogue.zh: 媽咪，我今晚唔想刷牙呀。

dialogue.en: But little sugar bugs are hiding on your teeth!
dialogue.zh: 但係啲糖蟲匿埋喺你啲牙度呀！

dialogue.en: Sugar bugs? I'm scared!
dialogue.zh: 糖蟲？我好驚呀！

dialogue.en: Don't worry, your toothbrush is very strong.
dialogue.zh: 唔使怕，你把牙刷好勁㗎。

dialogue.en: Then let's brush them all away!
dialogue.zh: 咁我哋刷走佢哋啦！

dialogue.en: Yes! Brush, brush, brush — bye-bye bugs!
dialogue.zh: 係呀！刷刷刷——拜拜蟲蟲！

dialogue.en: Look, my tooth is happy now!
dialogue.zh: 你睇，我隻牙而家好開心呀！

dialogue.en: And your smile is so bright!
dialogue.zh: 你個笑容好燦爛呀！

dialogue.en: Once upon a time, a Cavity Monster wanted to eat your teeth.
dialogue.zh: 從前有一隻蛀牙怪獸，想食你啲牙。

dialogue.en: A monster? What does it look like?
dialogue.zh: 怪獸？佢生成點㗎？

dialogue.en: It's tiny and sticky, and it loves leftover sugar.
dialogue.zh: 佢好細粒又黐立立，最鍾意食剩低嘅糖。

dialogue.en: Then I must be brave and fight it!
dialogue.zh: 咁我要勇敢啲同佢打呀！

dialogue.en: Your toothbrush is your magic sword.
dialogue.zh: 你把牙刷就係你嘅魔法劍。

dialogue.en: Take that! Up and down, up and down!
dialogue.zh: 食我一招！上下刷、上下刷！

dialogue.en: The monster is running away from all the bubbles!
dialogue.zh: 啲泡泡嚇到隻怪獸走晒呀！

dialogue.en: Did I win, Mama?
dialogue.zh: 我贏咗未呀媽咪？

dialogue.en: You did! Your teeth are shiny and clean.
dialogue.zh: 贏咗喇！你啲牙又閃又乾淨。

dialogue.en: I promise to brush every night!
dialogue.zh: 我承諾以後每晚都刷牙！

dialogue.en: I'm so proud of my little winner.
dialogue.zh: 我為我個小勝利者感到好自豪。

dialogue.en: The Cavity Monster will never come back!
dialogue.zh: 蛀牙怪獸以後都唔敢返嚟喇！

dialogue.en: I'm too grumpy to brush tonight, Mama. Leave me alone!
dialogue.zh: 我今晚扭計唔想刷牙呀媽咪。唔好理我啦！

dialogue.en: Uh-oh… then the sneaky Plaque Goblins will throw a party in your mouth.
dialogue.zh: 大鑊喇……咁鬼鬼鼠鼠嘅牙菌膜妖精就會喺你把口開派對㗎喇。

dialogue.en: A party? What are they even celebrating?
dialogue.zh: 開派對？佢哋慶祝啲乜嘢啫？

dialogue.en: They dance on the sugar you left after dinner and dig little holes.
dialogue.zh: 佢哋喺你晚飯剩低嘅糖上面跳舞，仲挖啲細窿添。

dialogue.en: Not in MY mouth! Quick, hand me my armour!
dialogue.zh: 唔准喺我把口度！快啲,俾件盔甲我!

dialogue.en: Here's your trusty toothbrush — squeeze on the minty magic gel.
dialogue.zh: 呢把就係你嘅忠實牙刷——唧啲薄荷魔法啫喱上去。

dialogue.en: Charge! I'll scrub them off in little circles!
dialogue.zh: 衝呀！我用刷圈圈嘅招式刷走佢哋!

dialogue.en: Look, your whole mouth is foamy — the goblins are slipping everywhere!
dialogue.zh: 你睇,成把口都係泡泡——啲妖精周圍滑倒呀!

dialogue.en: But some are stubborn and won't let go of my back teeth!
dialogue.zh: 但係有啲好頑固,死攬住我後面啲牙唔放呀!

dialogue.en: Then reach right to the very back and give them one last swish.
dialogue.zh: 咁就伸到最入面,再漱多一下,俾佢哋致命一擊。

dialogue.en: Swish… gone! Did I defeat them all?
dialogue.zh: 漱……唔見晒!我係咪打敗晒佢哋喇?

dialogue.en: Every last one. Look how your teeth are gleaming in the mirror.
dialogue.zh: 一隻都唔留。你睇下鏡入面,你啲牙幾咁閃令令。

dialogue.en: I really am a tooth hero, aren't I?
dialogue.zh: 我真係一個護牙英雄,係咪呀?

dialogue.en: The bravest one I know. And here's your reward — a big bedtime cuddle.
dialogue.zh: 我識嘅最勇敢嗰個。呢個就係你嘅獎勵——瞓覺前一個大擁抱。

dialogue.en: Best reward ever! Same battle tomorrow night?
dialogue.zh: 史上最好嘅獎勵!聽晚係咪又打過?

dialogue.en: Same time, same brave hero. Sweet dreams, my champion.
dialogue.zh: 同一時間,同一個勇敢英雄。發個好夢,我嘅冠軍。

task.K3: 擺早餐上枱時，叫小朋友用英文講出每樣食物名，講啱一個就開心拍手。
task.P1: 問小朋友「What do you want for breakfast?」，鼓勵佢用英文完整句子答，例如「I'd like some toast, please.」
task.P2: 去茶記食早餐時，叫小朋友用英文形容食物：crispy、runny yolk、steaming hot，練習描述細節同禮貌用語。

dialogue.en: Good morning! Are you hungry?
dialogue.zh: 早晨！你肚唔肚餓呀？

dialogue.en: Yes, Mama, my tummy is rumbling.
dialogue.zh: 係呀媽咪，我個肚咕咕聲呀。

dialogue.en: Here is some bread and an egg.
dialogue.zh: 呢度有麵包同埋一隻蛋。

dialogue.en: Can I have milk too, please?
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以埋要杯奶呀，唔該？

dialogue.en: Of course. Sit down at your plate.
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦。坐低喺你個碟前面。

dialogue.en: I love bananas! Can I eat one?
dialogue.zh: 我最鍾意香蕉！我可以食一條呀？

dialogue.en: Yes, but finish your egg first.
dialogue.zh: 得呀，不過要先食晒隻蛋。

dialogue.en: Okay! This breakfast is so yummy!
dialogue.zh: 好呀！呢餐早餐好好味呀！

dialogue.en: What would you like for breakfast today?
dialogue.zh: 你今朝想食啲乜嘢做早餐呀？

dialogue.en: Can I have some cereal with cold milk?
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以食麥片加凍奶呀？

dialogue.en: Sure. Do you want toast on the side?
dialogue.zh: 得呀。使唔使加多士呀？

dialogue.en: Yes please, with butter and strawberry jam.
dialogue.zh: 要呀唔該，搽牛油同埋士多啤梨果醬。

dialogue.en: Let me spread it for you while it's warm.
dialogue.zh: 趁多士仲暖,等我幫你搽啦。

dialogue.en: The cereal is so crunchy this morning!
dialogue.zh: 啲麥片今朝好脆卜卜呀！

dialogue.en: Careful, don't pour too much milk in.
dialogue.zh: 小心啲,唔好倒咁多奶落去。

dialogue.en: Oops, a little spilled. Can I have a napkin?
dialogue.zh: 哎吔,漏咗少少。可唔可以俾張餐巾我呀？

dialogue.en: Here you go. Would you like some orange juice?
dialogue.zh: 俾你。要唔要杯橙汁呀？

dialogue.en: Yes! Can I share my toast with you, Mama?
dialogue.zh: 要呀！我可唔可以同你分享我嘅多士呀媽咪？

dialogue.en: That's so kind of you. Just a little bite.
dialogue.zh: 你真係好乖。咬一啖就得喇。

dialogue.en: Eating together is the best!
dialogue.zh: 一齊食嘢至開心！

dialogue.en: Morning, sunshine! I'm making scrambled eggs — can you hear them sizzle?
dialogue.zh: 早晨呀小太陽！我整緊炒蛋——你聽唔聽到啲蛋滋滋聲呀？

dialogue.en: Mmm, it smells amazing! Can mine have a runny yolk instead?
dialogue.zh: 嗯,好香呀！我嗰隻可唔可以整流心蛋呀？

dialogue.en: Sure thing — one soft, golden, runny yolk coming right up.
dialogue.zh: 冇問題——一隻金黃流心蛋即刻嚟。

dialogue.en: And can I have the toast really crispy, almost a bit dark?
dialogue.zh: 仲有,多士可唔可以焗到好脆,有少少燶咁呀？

dialogue.en: Crispy it is. Careful, the plate is steaming hot.
dialogue.zh: 得,整脆佢。小心啲,個碟熱辣辣呀。

dialogue.en: The yolk broke and it's oozing all over my toast!
dialogue.zh: 蛋黃穿咗,流到成塊多士都係呀!

dialogue.en: That's the best part — dip your toast right in like a little spoon.
dialogue.zh: 嗰度最好食㗎——攞塊多士篤落去,好似隻匙羹咁。

dialogue.en: It's so warm and buttery! Should I gobble it or nibble it?
dialogue.zh: 好暖又好牛油味呀!我應該狼吞虎嚥定係細細啖咬呀?

dialogue.en: Nibble slowly so you can actually taste it, cheeky monkey.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢細啖咬,咁先食得出個味,你隻馬騮精。

dialogue.en: Can you drizzle a tiny bit of honey on the side too?
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以喺隔籬淋少少蜂蜜呀?

dialogue.en: Just a drizzle — we don't want you bouncing off the walls.
dialogue.zh: 淋少少啫——唔想你食完周圍彈跳呀。

dialogue.en: These eggs are so fluffy, like little yellow clouds!
dialogue.zh: 啲蛋好鬆軟呀,好似黃色嘅雲仔咁!

dialogue.en: I'm glad you like them. Don't forget your milk, it's good for your bones.
dialogue.zh: 你鍾意就好喇。咪唔記得飲奶,對骨骼好㗎。

dialogue.en: All gone! That was absolutely delicious, Mama.
dialogue.zh: 飲晒喇!真係好美味呀媽咪。

dialogue.en: You wolfed that down fast! Ready to take on the whole day now?
dialogue.zh: 你食得好快呀!而家準備好應付成日未呀?

dialogue.en: Ready as a rocket — full tummy, big smile!
dialogue.zh: 準備到好似火箭咁!食到飽飽,笑到見牙唔見眼!

dialogue.en: I don't want breakfast. I'm too sleepy.
dialogue.zh: 我唔想食早餐呀,眼瞓到不得了。

dialogue.en: But I made your favourite pancakes!
dialogue.zh: 但係我整咗你最鍾意嘅班戟呀!

dialogue.en: No, I don't want to eat.
dialogue.zh: 唔要,我唔想食呀。

dialogue.en: Just smell them. Aren't they nice?
dialogue.zh: 聞下佢啦,係咪好香呀?

dialogue.en: Mmm… okay, I will try one bite.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……好啦,我試咬一啖。

dialogue.en: Do you like it?
dialogue.zh: 你鍾唔鍾意呀?

dialogue.en: Yummy! I want to finish them all!
dialogue.zh: 好味呀!我要食晒佢!

dialogue.en: Now your tummy is full and happy!
dialogue.zh: 而家你個肚飽飽又開心喇!

dialogue.en: Mama, I'm late for school! I'll skip breakfast.
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,我返學遲到喇!唔食早餐喇。

dialogue.en: Wait, sweetie, you can't learn well on an empty tummy.
dialogue.zh: 等陣,乖女,空肚係唔會學得好㗎。

dialogue.en: But there's no time to sit and eat!
dialogue.zh: 但係冇時間坐低食嘢呀!

dialogue.en: Then grab this banana and a slice of toast to go.
dialogue.zh: 咁攞條香蕉同一塊多士,行住食啦。

dialogue.en: Oh, I can eat while I put on my shoes?
dialogue.zh: 哦,我可以一路著鞋一路食呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, but eat slowly so you don't choke.
dialogue.zh: 得,不過慢慢食,咪哽親。

dialogue.en: This toast is actually really tasty!
dialogue.zh: 呢塊多士其實好好食喎!

dialogue.en: And now you'll have energy for class.
dialogue.zh: 而家你就有精力上堂喇。

dialogue.en: You're right, I feel more awake now.
dialogue.zh: 你講得啱,我而家精神咗喇。

dialogue.en: Tomorrow let's wake up earlier, okay?
dialogue.zh: 聽日我哋早啲起身,好唔好?

dialogue.en: Okay! Then I can eat sitting down like a big girl.
dialogue.zh: 好呀!咁我就可以好似大個女咁坐低食。

dialogue.en: That's my smart girl. Now off you go!
dialogue.zh: 真係叻女。快啲出發啦!

dialogue.en: I woke up in a bad mood and I don't feel like eating anything.
dialogue.zh: 我起身心情唔好,咩都唔想食呀。

dialogue.en: Oh dear, someone got out of bed on the wrong side today.
dialogue.zh: 哎呀,有人今日起身脾氣唔好喎。

dialogue.en: Even my tummy is grumbling but I still don't want food.
dialogue.zh: 連我個肚都咕咕叫,但係我都係唔想食嘢。

dialogue.en: Well, I just happened to make fluffy French toast, dusted with sugar.
dialogue.zh: 咁啱我整咗鬆軟嘅西多士,仲灑咗糖粉添。

dialogue.en: Hmph. I'm not even going to look at it.
dialogue.zh: 哼。我睇都唔睇佢。

dialogue.en: That's fine… but can you smell that warm, sweet aroma drifting over?
dialogue.zh: 冇所謂……不過你聞唔聞到陣暖笠笠嘅甜香飄埋嚟呀?

dialogue.en: Okay, that does smell really tempting…
dialogue.zh: 好啦,真係聞落好誘人喎……

dialogue.en: Just one little taste. I promise it melts in your mouth.
dialogue.zh: 試一小啖啫。我保證入口即溶。

dialogue.en: Mmm! It's so soft and the sugar melts on my tongue!
dialogue.zh: 嗯!好軟呀,啲糖喺條脷度即刻溶晒!

dialogue.en: See? A tasty breakfast can chase a grumpy mood away.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?一餐好嘢食可以趕走個衰脾氣。

dialogue.en: I think my bad mood is starting to melt too, like the sugar.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得我個衰脾氣好似啲糖咁,開始融化喇。

dialogue.en: There's my girl. Let's savour every bite together, slowly.
dialogue.zh: 呢個先係我個乖女。我哋一齊慢慢細味每一啖啦。

dialogue.en: Can we add some banana slices on top? That would be perfect.
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以喺上面加啲香蕉片呀?咁就完美喇。

dialogue.en: Great idea — a few golden slices to make it extra mouthwatering.
dialogue.zh: 好主意——加幾片金黃香蕉,令佢更加令人流口水。

dialogue.en: Thank you, Mama. My whole day feels brighter now.
dialogue.zh: 多謝你媽咪。我成日都開朗返晒喇。

dialogue.en: A full tummy and a happy heart — that's the best way to start a day.
dialogue.zh: 食到飽飽,開開心心——係開始新一日嘅最好方法。

task.K3: 著衫時叫小朋友用英文講出每件衫嘅名（shirt、socks、shoes），著啱一件就讚佢。
task.P1: 問「What colour do you want to wear today?」，鼓勵小朋友用英文講顏色同衫種,再自己揀衫。
task.P2: 睇天氣揀衫,叫小朋友用英文形容 cozy、matching、too tight,練習描述觸感同合唔合身。

dialogue.en: Time to get dressed! Here is your shirt.
dialogue.zh: 著衫喇!呢件係你件衫。

dialogue.en: I can put it on by myself!
dialogue.zh: 我識自己著㗎!

dialogue.en: Great! Now your pants and socks.
dialogue.zh: 好叻!而家著褲同襪。

dialogue.en: Which shoes should I wear today?
dialogue.zh: 我今日著邊對鞋好呢?

dialogue.en: The red ones look nice with your shirt.
dialogue.zh: 對紅色鞋襯你件衫喎。

dialogue.en: Can I wear my hat too?
dialogue.zh: 我可唔可以埋戴頂帽呀?

dialogue.en: Yes! Let me help with the buttons.
dialogue.zh: 得!等我幫你扣鈕。

dialogue.en: All done! I'm ready to go!
dialogue.zh: 搞掂喇!我準備好出發喇!

dialogue.en: What would you like to wear today?
dialogue.zh: 你今日想著啲乜嘢呀?

dialogue.en: Can I wear my blue dress, please?
dialogue.zh: 我可唔可以著我條藍色裙呀,唔該?

dialogue.en: Good choice! But it might be cold outside.
dialogue.zh: 揀得好!不過出面可能會凍。

dialogue.en: Then I'll put a jacket over it.
dialogue.zh: 咁我喺上面加件外套。

dialogue.en: Perfect. Can you do the zipper yourself?
dialogue.zh: 好!你識唔識自己拉拉鏈呀?

dialogue.en: Almost… it's a little stuck at the bottom.
dialogue.zh: 就快得……底部有少少卡住。

dialogue.en: Let me help. There you go, all zipped up.
dialogue.zh: 等我幫手。搞掂,拉晒喇。

dialogue.en: Do my socks match my dress?
dialogue.zh: 我對襪襯唔襯我條裙呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, the matching colours look lovely.
dialogue.zh: 襯呀,同色系睇落好靚。

dialogue.en: Can I check myself in the mirror?
dialogue.zh: 我可唔可以照下鏡呀?

dialogue.en: Of course. Don't you look smart!
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦。你睇你幾精神!

dialogue.en: I love getting dressed all by myself!
dialogue.zh: 我最鍾意自己著衫喇!

dialogue.en: Brr, it's a chilly, drizzly morning — let's pick something cozy.
dialogue.zh: 凍到震呀,今朝濕濕地又凍,揀啲暖笠笠嘅嚟著啦。

dialogue.en: Can I wear my fluffy pink jumper? It's so soft and warm.
dialogue.zh: 我可唔可以著我件毛毛粉紅色冷衫呀?好軟又好暖。

dialogue.en: Perfect choice. Let's layer a shirt underneath to keep you snug.
dialogue.zh: 揀得好。入面加件底衫,咁就更加暖笠笠。

dialogue.en: This shirt is all wrinkled from the drawer, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過呢件底衫喺櫃桶度攞出嚟,皺晒喎。

dialogue.en: A few wrinkles won't matter once your jumper's on top.
dialogue.zh: 著咗件冷衫喺上面,少少皺都睇唔到嘅。

dialogue.en: The sleeves are a bit long — they cover my whole hands!
dialogue.zh: 啲衫袖有少少長——遮晒我對手!

dialogue.en: Just roll them up twice, like little cuffs. There, much better.
dialogue.zh: 捲起佢兩摺,好似袖口咁。好喇,好睇好多。

dialogue.en: Should I tuck my shirt into my pants or leave it out?
dialogue.zh: 我應該將件衫塞入褲度定係放出嚟呀?

dialogue.en: Leave it out today, it looks comfier and more relaxed.
dialogue.zh: 今日放出嚟啦,睇落舒服啲又輕鬆啲。

dialogue.en: My jeans are super stretchy, so I can jump really high in them!
dialogue.zh: 我條牛仔褲好有彈性,所以我著住可以跳好高!

dialogue.en: Save the jumping for the playground. Let's fasten your shoes.
dialogue.zh: 跳嘅嘢留返去遊樂場先。嚟,綁好對鞋。

dialogue.en: Can you fix my collar? It's folded funny on one side.
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以整下我個領呀?一邊摺到怪怪哋。

dialogue.en: There — collar flat, buttons done. What a smart little outfit!
dialogue.zh: 好喇——個領攤平,啲鈕扣好。呢套衫幾襯呀!

dialogue.en: Watch me twirl! Does my dress puff out like a princess?
dialogue.zh: 睇我轉圈圈!我條裙係咪好似公主咁扯起呀?

dialogue.en: Just like a princess. Now grab your umbrella for the rain.
dialogue.zh: 真係好似公主咁。而家攞把遮,落雨呀。

dialogue.en: Cozy, comfy, and ready for anything — let's go!
dialogue.zh: 暖笠笠,舒舒服服,乜都準備好——出發喇!

dialogue.en: Brrr! I feel so cold, Mama.
dialogue.zh: 凍呀!我覺得好凍呀媽咪。

dialogue.en: You are shivering! Let's put on your coat.
dialogue.zh: 你打冷震呀!嚟著件大褸。

dialogue.en: Okay, the coat is soft and warm.
dialogue.zh: 好呀,件大褸又軟又暖。

dialogue.en: Now here is your scarf and gloves.
dialogue.zh: 而家戴頸巾同手套。

dialogue.en: My hands feel warm now!
dialogue.zh: 我對手而家暖返喇!

dialogue.en: Are you still cold?
dialogue.zh: 仲凍唔凍呀?

dialogue.en: No, I feel snug and cozy now!
dialogue.zh: 唔凍喇,我而家暖笠笠好舒服!

dialogue.en: Good! Now you can go out and play with a smile.
dialogue.zh: 好!而家你可以開開心心出去玩喇。

dialogue.en: I only want to wear my superhero costume today!
dialogue.zh: 我今日淨係想著我套超級英雄裝!

dialogue.en: But we're going to a birthday party, sweetie.
dialogue.zh: 但係我哋要去生日會喎,乖女。

dialogue.en: I don't care, I insist on my cape!
dialogue.zh: 我唔理,我一定要著我件斗篷!

dialogue.en: It's chilly outside — you'll shiver in just that.
dialogue.zh: 出面好凍——淨係著咁樣你會冷親。

dialogue.en: But normal clothes are so boring!
dialogue.zh: 但係著普通衫好悶呀!

dialogue.en: How about we make a deal, a clever compromise?
dialogue.zh: 不如我哋做個交易,一個聰明嘅妥協,好唔好?

dialogue.en: What kind of deal, Mama?
dialogue.zh: 咩交易呀媽咪?

dialogue.en: Wear your warm clothes, and your cape on top!
dialogue.zh: 著返啲暖衫,再喺上面披件斗篷!

dialogue.en: Ooh, then I'm a warm superhero!
dialogue.zh: 哦,咁我就係一個暖笠笠嘅超級英雄!

dialogue.en: Exactly! Do you agree to that?
dialogue.zh: 啱喇!你同唔同意呀?

dialogue.en: Yes! Best idea ever! Cape on!
dialogue.zh: 同意!史上最好嘅主意!披斗篷!

dialogue.en: Off we go, my cozy little hero.
dialogue.zh: 出發喇,我個暖笠笠嘅小英雄。

dialogue.en: I want to get dressed all by myself today — no help, please!
dialogue.zh: 我今日想自己著晒所有衫——唔該唔好幫我!

dialogue.en: Alright, my independent big girl. I'll just watch from here.
dialogue.zh: 好呀,我個獨立嘅大個女。我喺度睇住就得喇。

dialogue.en: Ugh! My arm won't go through — the sleeve is all tangled up!
dialogue.zh: 唉!我隻手伸唔到出去——個袖纏成一舊呀!

dialogue.en: Take a breath. The shirt looks like it might be inside out.
dialogue.zh: 抖啖氣先。件衫好似著咗轉㗎喎。

dialogue.en: Oh no, it IS backwards! And now I'm getting frustrated.
dialogue.zh: 哎吔,真係著反咗!而家我開始激氣喇。

dialogue.en: That happens to everyone. Turn it around and try again slowly.
dialogue.zh: 個個都試過㗎。反返轉,慢慢再試多次。

dialogue.en: There! It's on the right way now. But these buttons are so tricky.
dialogue.zh: 得喇!而家著啱喇。不過啲鈕好難扣呀。

dialogue.en: Start from the bottom button — that way they always line up.
dialogue.zh: 由最底嗰粒鈕開始扣——咁樣就永遠對得齊。

dialogue.en: Bottom first… one, two, three… hey, they all matched up!
dialogue.zh: 先扣底部……一、二、三……嘩,全部都對齊晒!

dialogue.en: See? A little patience and you figured it out yourself.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?有少少耐性,你就自己搞掂咗喇。

dialogue.en: Now just my shoes… but the laces keep flopping everywhere!
dialogue.zh: 仲差對鞋……但係啲鞋帶周圍飛呀!

dialogue.en: Make two bunny ears and cross them over — you've almost got it.
dialogue.zh: 整兩隻兔仔耳仔,交叉咁綁——你就快得喇。

dialogue.en: Bunny ears, cross, and pull… I did it! I tied them myself!
dialogue.zh: 兔仔耳仔,交叉,拉……我做到喇!我自己綁到喇!

dialogue.en: I'm bursting with pride! You dressed yourself from head to toe.
dialogue.zh: 我自豪到爆呀!你由頭到腳自己著晒衫。

dialogue.en: I feel so grown-up and triumphant right now!
dialogue.zh: 我而家覺得好似大個咗咁,得意洋洋呀!

dialogue.en: You earned that big smile, my determined little star. Let's go!
dialogue.zh: 你個大笑容係應得嘅,我個有決心嘅小星星。出發喇!

task.K3: 執書包時,叫小朋友用英文講出袋入面每樣嘢(book、pencil、bottle),數齊就出門。
task.P1: 返學路上玩「I spy」,叫小朋友用英文講出見到嘅嘢(bus、tree、light),練習日常詞彙。
task.P2: 搭港鐵或巴士返學時,叫小朋友用英文形容 crowded、squeeze、mind the gap,練習描述通勤細節。

dialogue.en: Do you have everything in your bag?
dialogue.zh: 你書包入面啲嘢齊唔齊呀?

dialogue.en: Yes! My book and my pencil.
dialogue.zh: 齊!我本書同枝鉛筆。

dialogue.en: Don't forget your water bottle.
dialogue.zh: 咪唔記得帶水樽。

dialogue.en: Got it! Is the bus here yet?
dialogue.zh: 攞咗!架巴士到咗未呀?

dialogue.en: Almost. Hold my hand at the road.
dialogue.zh: 就快。過馬路捉實我隻手。

dialogue.en: I want to see my teacher today!
dialogue.zh: 我今日想見我老師呀!

dialogue.en: And all your friends too!
dialogue.zh: 仲有你啲朋友添!

dialogue.en: Bye Mama! I love school!
dialogue.zh: 拜拜媽咪!我最鍾意返學!

dialogue.en: Hurry, sweetie, we don't want to miss the bus.
dialogue.zh: 快啲呀乖女,唔好搭唔到巴士。

dialogue.en: I'm coming! Is my homework in my bag?
dialogue.zh: 嚟緊喇!我啲功課喺書包度嗎?

dialogue.en: Yes, I packed it with your lunchbox.
dialogue.zh: 係,我同你個飯盒一齊擺咗入去。

dialogue.en: Good, I don't want to forget it again.
dialogue.zh: 好,我唔想再唔記得帶。

dialogue.en: Wait at the crossing and hold my hand.
dialogue.zh: 喺斑馬線度等,捉實我隻手。

dialogue.en: The light is green now — can we go?
dialogue.zh: 綠燈喇——可唔可以行呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, walk quickly but carefully.
dialogue.zh: 得,行快啲但係要小心。

dialogue.en: There's my school gate! I see my friends.
dialogue.zh: 見到校門喇!我見到我啲朋友。

dialogue.en: Remember to be polite to your teacher.
dialogue.zh: 記得要對老師有禮貌。

dialogue.en: I will! Can you pick me up after school?
dialogue.zh: 我會㗎!你放學會唔會嚟接我呀?

dialogue.en: Of course. I'll wave to you right here.
dialogue.zh: 梗係啦。我會喺呢度同你揮手。

dialogue.en: Goodbye, Mama! See you later!
dialogue.zh: 拜拜媽咪!遲啲見!

dialogue.en: Come on, love, it's rush hour and the MTR will be packed.
dialogue.zh: 快啲呀寶貝,而家繁忙時間,港鐵會好逼㗎。

dialogue.en: Can I tap my own Octopus card on the reader today?
dialogue.zh: 我今日可唔可以自己拍八達通呀?

dialogue.en: Sure — tap it flat and wait for the little beep.
dialogue.zh: 得——平放咁拍,等佢嘟一聲。

dialogue.en: Beep! It turned green. Now up the escalator, right?
dialogue.zh: 嘟!變綠色喇。而家上扶手電梯,係咪?

dialogue.en: Yes, hold the rail — it's slippery and everyone's in a hurry.
dialogue.zh: 係,揸實扶手——好跣,大家又趕時間。

dialogue.en: Wow, the platform is so bustling this morning!
dialogue.zh: 嘩,今朝個月台好多人熙來攘往呀!

dialogue.en: It always is. When the doors open, mind the gap as you step in.
dialogue.zh: 一向都係咁㗎。開門嗰陣,上車小心月台空隙。

dialogue.en: It's so crowded — I can barely find a place to stand!
dialogue.zh: 好逼呀——我幾乎搵唔到位企!

dialogue.en: Squeeze in close to me and hold the pole tightly.
dialogue.zh: 逼埋嚟我身邊,揸實條扶手柱。

dialogue.en: The lady on the speaker just announced our stop!
dialogue.zh: 廣播嗰位女士啱啱報咗我哋個站!

dialogue.en: Well spotted. Let's weave our way towards the doors.
dialogue.zh: 聽得好清楚。我哋穿過人群行埋去門口啦。

dialogue.en: Mind the gap again! I hopped right over it.
dialogue.zh: 又要小心月台空隙!我一嘢跳咗過去。

dialogue.en: Nicely done. The school's just a short walk from here.
dialogue.zh: 做得好。學校喺呢度行一陣就到。

dialogue.en: We made it right on time — no rushing at the gate!
dialogue.zh: 我哋啱啱好準時到——唔使喺校門度趕!

dialogue.en: See? Leaving early means a calm, punctual start.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?早啲出門就可以輕輕鬆鬆準時到。

dialogue.en: I love our morning commute — it's like a little adventure!
dialogue.zh: 我鍾意我哋朝早呢段路程——好似一場小冒險咁!

dialogue.en: Mama, I feel shy. I don't want to go in.
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,我好怕醜。我唔想入去呀。

dialogue.en: It's okay to feel shy on your first day.
dialogue.zh: 第一日返學怕醜係好正常㗎。

dialogue.en: What if I want to cry?
dialogue.zh: 如果我想喊點算呀?

dialogue.en: Then have a big hug from me first.
dialogue.zh: 咁就先攬我一個大擁抱。

dialogue.en: Okay… I feel a little braver now.
dialogue.zh: 好啦……我而家勇敢咗少少。

dialogue.en: Look, the other children are playing!
dialogue.zh: 你睇,其他小朋友喺度玩緊呀!

dialogue.en: That looks like fun! Can I join them?
dialogue.zh: 好似好好玩喎!我可唔可以加入佢哋呀?

dialogue.en: Yes! Go and make a new friend. Have a happy day!
dialogue.zh: 得!去識個新朋友啦。祝你有開心嘅一日!

dialogue.en: Mama, I'm nervous. I don't know anyone here.
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,我好緊張。我喺度一個人都唔識。

dialogue.en: I know, starting somewhere new can feel scary.
dialogue.zh: 我知,去到新地方係會覺得驚㗎。

dialogue.en: What if I forget where my classroom is?
dialogue.zh: 如果我唔記得課室喺邊點算?

dialogue.en: Your teacher will kindly show you the way.
dialogue.zh: 你老師會好好心咁帶你去㗎。

dialogue.en: But what if the other kids don't like me?
dialogue.zh: 但係如果其他小朋友唔鍾意我呢?

dialogue.en: Just be yourself and smile — that always helps.
dialogue.zh: 做返自己,笑多啲——一定有幫助㗎。

dialogue.en: Okay. I'll try to be brave and say hello.
dialogue.zh: 好啦。我會試下勇敢啲同人講你好。

dialogue.en: That's the spirit. You belong here just as much as anyone.
dialogue.zh: 呢個先啱。你同其他人一樣屬於呢度。

dialogue.en: A girl just waved at me and smiled!
dialogue.zh: 有個女仔啱啱同我揮手又笑呀!

dialogue.en: See? You'll settle in before you know it.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?好快你就會適應㗎喇。

dialogue.en: You were right, Mama. I think today will be wonderful.
dialogue.zh: 你講得啱媽咪。我覺得今日會好精彩。

dialogue.en: I'm so proud of you. Go and shine, my brave girl.
dialogue.zh: 我為你感到好自豪。去發光發亮啦,我個勇敢嘅乖女。

dialogue.en: Please don't go, Mama — I want to stay home with you today.
dialogue.zh: 唔好走呀媽咪——我今日想留喺屋企同你一齊。

dialogue.en: Oh sweetheart, I can see you've got butterflies in your tummy.
dialogue.zh: 哎呀寶貝,我睇得出你個肚仔喺度心噏噏。

dialogue.en: My tummy feels all funny and my voice is going wobbly.
dialogue.zh: 我個肚怪怪哋,把聲又震震哋。

dialogue.en: That's just your nerves — they always fade once the day begins.
dialogue.zh: 嗰啲淨係緊張啫——一開始上堂就會慢慢消失㗎喇。

dialogue.en: But the classroom is so big and everything feels so new.
dialogue.zh: 但係個課室好大,所有嘢都好陌生。

dialogue.en: Remember our routine? A hug, a kiss, and three deep breaths.
dialogue.zh: 記唔記得我哋嘅慣例?一個攬,一啖錫,三下深呼吸。

dialogue.en: Okay… breathe in… breathe out… that does feel a bit better.
dialogue.zh: 好啦……吸氣……呼氣……真係好返少少喎。

dialogue.en: Look, there's the reading corner you loved last week.
dialogue.zh: 你睇,嗰度就係你上星期好鍾意嘅閱讀角。

dialogue.en: Oh yes! And my drawing is still up on the wall!
dialogue.zh: 係喎!我幅畫仲貼喺牆度呀!

dialogue.en: See how quickly a strange place starts to feel familiar?
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?一個陌生嘅地方好快就變得熟悉。

dialogue.en: I think I can be brave now. Will you really come back?
dialogue.zh: 我覺得我而家可以勇敢喇。你真係會返嚟接我㗎?

dialogue.en: I promise, right after your last lesson — I always do.
dialogue.zh: 我保證,你最後一堂完就返嚟——我從來都係咁㗎。

dialogue.en: Then I'll go and find that girl who shared her crayons.
dialogue.zh: 咁我入去搵嗰個借咗蠟筆我嘅女仔啦。

dialogue.en: That's my brave girl, full of courage. Go and blossom today.
dialogue.zh: 呢個先係我勇敢嘅乖女,充滿勇氣。今日入去綻放啦。

dialogue.en: Bye, Mama! I'll tell you all about it after school!
dialogue.zh: 拜拜媽咪!放學我會將所有嘢話晒你知!

dialogue.en: I can't wait to hear every little detail. I love you.
dialogue.zh: 我好期待聽你講每一個細節。我愛你。

task.K3: 玩玩具時叫小朋友用英文講出每件玩具嘅名(ball、doll、blocks),講啱就一齊玩。
task.P1: 扮玩具店老闆同顧客,叫小朋友用英文問價錢同介紹玩具,練習禮貌對答。
task.P2: 玩完之後叫小朋友一齊執玩具,用英文形容 scattered、sort、tidy up,練習描述同分類。

dialogue.en: Mama, can we play with my toys?
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,我哋可唔可以玩我啲玩具呀?

dialogue.en: Yes! What do you want to play with?
dialogue.zh: 得!你想玩啲乜嘢呀?

dialogue.en: Let's build a tower with the blocks!
dialogue.zh: 我哋用積木砌個塔啦!

dialogue.en: Great idea! Pass me a red block.
dialogue.zh: 好主意!俾一嚿紅色積木我。

dialogue.en: Here you go. Now it's so tall!
dialogue.zh: 俾你。而家好高呀!

dialogue.en: Can I play with your teddy too?
dialogue.zh: 我可唔可以玩埋你隻熊仔呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, I like to share my toys.
dialogue.zh: 得,我鍾意同人分享玩具。

dialogue.en: You're so kind! This is so much fun.
dialogue.zh: 你真係好乖!好好玩呀。

dialogue.en: Can we do the puzzle together, Mama?
dialogue.zh: 我哋一齊砌砌圖好唔好呀媽咪?

dialogue.en: Sure! Let's find the corner pieces first.
dialogue.zh: 好!我哋先搵啲角落嘅塊。

dialogue.en: I found one! Where does it go?
dialogue.zh: 我搵到一塊!放邊度呀?

dialogue.en: Try the top — it looks like the sky.
dialogue.zh: 試下擺上面——好似係天空。

dialogue.en: It fits! Now let's build my robot.
dialogue.zh: 啱位!而家我哋砌我個機械人。

dialogue.en: Okay, but let's take turns pressing the buttons.
dialogue.zh: 好,不過我哋輪流撳掣。

dialogue.en: Uh oh, one arm came off!
dialogue.zh: 哎吔,一隻手甩咗!

dialogue.en: Don't worry, we can fix it together.
dialogue.zh: 唔使擔心,我哋一齊整返好佢。

dialogue.en: You clicked it back on! You're so clever.
dialogue.zh: 你㩒返佢返去喇!你好叻呀。

dialogue.en: Now let's pretend the robot can talk.
dialogue.zh: 而家我哋扮個機械人識講嘢。

dialogue.en: Beep boop! I am Robot, hello!
dialogue.zh: 嘟嘟!我係機械人,你好!

dialogue.en: Ha ha! Playing with you is the best.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈!同你玩最開心喇。

dialogue.en: Mama, let's build the tallest tower in the whole world!
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,我哋砌全世界最高嘅塔啦!

dialogue.en: Ooh, ambitious! Let's stack the big blocks at the bottom first.
dialogue.zh: 嘩,好有野心!我哋先將大嚿積木疊喺底部。

dialogue.en: Why the big ones at the bottom?
dialogue.zh: 點解大嚿要放喺底部呀?

dialogue.en: A wide, sturdy base keeps the whole thing balanced.
dialogue.zh: 又闊又穩固嘅底座先可以令成個塔平衡。

dialogue.en: Look how high it's getting — it's up to my nose now!
dialogue.zh: 你睇佢越嚟越高——已經到我個鼻度喇!

dialogue.en: Steady now, add the next one gently. It's starting to wobble.
dialogue.zh: 穩陣啲,輕輕哋放上去。佢開始搖喇。

dialogue.en: Uh oh… wobble, wobble… CRASH! It all toppled over!
dialogue.zh: 哎吔……搖下搖下……轟隆!全部冧晒!

dialogue.en: Ha! That was a spectacular crash. Shall we rebuild it?
dialogue.zh: 哈!呢個轟然倒下好壯觀。我哋重新砌過好唔好?

dialogue.en: Yes! This time let's make it a fortress with a cardboard gate.
dialogue.zh: 好!今次我哋整個城堡,再用紙皮做度門。

dialogue.en: Brilliant use of your imagination. I'll hold the gate steady.
dialogue.zh: 你嘅想像力用得好好。我幫手扶穩度門。

dialogue.en: Now my teddy can be the king who guards the castle!
dialogue.zh: 而家我隻熊仔可以做守衛城堡嘅國王!

dialogue.en: A very brave king indeed. Careful — one side is leaning.
dialogue.zh: 真係一個好勇敢嘅國王。小心——一邊側緊。

dialogue.en: I'll add a block here to balance it. There, all sturdy!
dialogue.zh: 我喺呢度加嚿積木平衡佢。好喇,穩固晒!

dialogue.en: Now that is a proper masterpiece. Well built, my little architect!
dialogue.zh: 呢個先算得上係傑作。砌得好,我個小建築師!

dialogue.en: Don't let it collapse this time — no sneezing near it!
dialogue.zh: 今次唔准佢塌落嚟——唔准喺附近打乞嗤!

dialogue.en: Ha! I'll hold my breath. Our fortress shall stand forever!
dialogue.zh: 哈!我會忍住唔呼吸。我哋座城堡要永遠企喺度!

dialogue.en: That's my ball! It's mine!
dialogue.zh: 嗰個係我個波!係我嘅!

dialogue.en: But teddy wants to play too.
dialogue.zh: 但係熊仔都想玩呀。

dialogue.en: No! Teddy grabbed it and made me sad.
dialogue.zh: 唔得!熊仔搶咗佢,搞到我好傷心。

dialogue.en: Maybe teddy can say sorry.
dialogue.zh: 不如熊仔講聲對唔住。

dialogue.en: Teddy says sorry to me.
dialogue.zh: 熊仔同我講對唔住。

dialogue.en: Now can you take turns with the ball?
dialogue.zh: 咁你哋可唔可以輪流玩個波呀?

dialogue.en: Okay! First me, then teddy.
dialogue.zh: 好!先我,再到熊仔。

dialogue.en: See? Playing together is more fun!
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?一齊玩好玩啲!

dialogue.en: Mama, I'm so bored. There's nothing to do.
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,我好悶呀。冇嘢做。

dialogue.en: Bored? But you have a whole box of toys!
dialogue.zh: 悶?但係你成箱玩具喎!

dialogue.en: I've played with all of them already.
dialogue.zh: 我全部都玩晒喇。

dialogue.en: Then let's use our imagination for an adventure.
dialogue.zh: 咁我哋用想像力嚟一場冒險啦。

dialogue.en: An adventure? Where would we go?
dialogue.zh: 冒險?我哋去邊度呀?

dialogue.en: This cardboard box can be our spaceship!
dialogue.zh: 呢個紙皮箱可以做我哋嘅太空船!

dialogue.en: Ooh! Then I'll be the captain!
dialogue.zh: 嘩!咁我做船長!

dialogue.en: Captain, where shall we explore first?
dialogue.zh: 船長,我哋先去探索邊度呀?

dialogue.en: To the red planet! Ready for blast off!
dialogue.zh: 去紅色星球!準備發射!

dialogue.en: Five, four, three, two, one — blast off!
dialogue.zh: 五、四、三、二、一——升空!

dialogue.en: This is the most exciting journey ever!
dialogue.zh: 呢個係史上最刺激嘅旅程!

dialogue.en: See? Boredom disappears with a little imagination.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?有少少想像力,個悶字就消失喇。

dialogue.en: Wow, your toys are scattered all over the floor like confetti!
dialogue.zh: 嘩,你啲玩具好似五彩紙碎咁散落成地!

dialogue.en: Do I really have to tidy up? Cleaning is such a boring chore.
dialogue.zh: 真係要執咩?執嘢好悶,好似做家務咁。

dialogue.en: What if we turn it into a race against the clock?
dialogue.zh: 不如我哋將佢變成同時間鬥快嘅比賽?

dialogue.en: A race? Ooh, that sounds more fun. What are the rules?
dialogue.zh: 比賽?哦,聽落好玩啲喎。有咩規則呀?

dialogue.en: We sort them into categories — blocks, cars, and dolls, each in its own box.
dialogue.zh: 我哋分類——積木、車仔、公仔,各自放入自己個箱。

dialogue.en: Okay! I'll grab all the blocks first — they're the messiest!
dialogue.zh: 好!我先執晒啲積木——佢哋最亂!

dialogue.en: Great teamwork! I'll gather the cars zooming under the sofa.
dialogue.zh: 團隊合作得好!我執晒啲鑽咗入梳化底嘅車仔。

dialogue.en: Found three dolls hiding behind the curtain! Sneaky things.
dialogue.zh: 喺窗簾後面搵到三個公仔!鬼鬼鼠鼠。

dialogue.en: Quick, into the box they go — we're nearly beating the clock!
dialogue.zh: 快啲,擺返入箱——我哋就快贏時間喇!

dialogue.en: Last piece… and… done! How much time did we take?
dialogue.zh: 最後一件……然後……搞掂!我哋用咗幾多時間呀?

dialogue.en: Under five minutes! Look how spotless the floor is now.
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘都唔使!你睇個地板而家幾咁乾淨。

dialogue.en: Wow, it actually feels really satisfying to see it all tidy.
dialogue.zh: 嘩,見到全部執得咁齊,真係好有滿足感喎。

dialogue.en: That's the secret — a tidy room makes your mind feel calm too.
dialogue.zh: 呢個就係秘訣——房間企理,個心都會平靜啲。

dialogue.en: Can we do the toy race again tomorrow? I want to beat my time!
dialogue.zh: 聽日可唔可以再玩執玩具比賽呀?我想打破自己嘅紀錄!

dialogue.en: Absolutely. And since you worked so hard, here's a little reward.
dialogue.zh: 梗係得。而且你咁落力,呢個係俾你嘅小獎勵。

dialogue.en: A sticker! I'll put it right on my toy box — mission accomplished!
dialogue.zh: 貼紙!我要貼喺我個玩具箱度——任務完成!

task.K3: 沖涼時叫小朋友用英文講出洗緊邊個部位(hair、hands、feet),洗一個講一個。
task.P1: 玩泡泡遊戲,叫小朋友用英文形容 bubbles、splash、slippery,一路玩一路講。
task.P2: 沖完涼叫小朋友用英文形容 warm、squeaky-clean、wrap up,練習描述舒適感受同細節。

dialogue.en: Bath time! The water is nice and warm.
dialogue.zh: 沖涼喇!啲水暖暖哋好舒服。

dialogue.en: Yay! Can I get in now?
dialogue.zh: 好呀!我可以入去喇?

dialogue.en: Yes, be careful. Let's wash your hair.
dialogue.zh: 得,小心啲。我哋洗頭啦。

dialogue.en: Not in my eyes, please!
dialogue.zh: 唔好入我眼呀,唔該!

dialogue.en: Don't worry, close your eyes tight.
dialogue.zh: 唔使驚,眼閉埋實。

dialogue.en: Now can I wash with the soap?
dialogue.zh: 而家我可以用番梘洗呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, wash your arms and tummy.
dialogue.zh: 得,洗下你對手同個肚。

dialogue.en: All clean! Where is my towel?
dialogue.zh: 洗乾淨喇!我條毛巾喺邊呀?

dialogue.en: Look at all these bubbles in your bath!
dialogue.zh: 你睇你個浴缸咁多泡泡!

dialogue.en: I love bubbles! My duck can float on them.
dialogue.zh: 我最鍾意泡泡!我隻鴨仔可以喺上面浮。

dialogue.en: It sure can. Let's put shampoo on your hair.
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦。我哋搽啲洗頭水落你頭髮。

dialogue.en: Can I make a bubble hat first?
dialogue.zh: 我可唔可以先整頂泡泡帽呀?

dialogue.en: Ha ha, okay, a big bubbly hat!
dialogue.zh: 哈哈,好呀,一頂大泡泡帽!

dialogue.en: Now scrub my back, it's ticklish!
dialogue.zh: 而家擦下我個背脊,好痕呀!

dialogue.en: Careful not to splash water everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 小心啲,唔好周圍濺水。

dialogue.en: Oops, too late! Splash splash!
dialogue.zh: 哎吔,遲喇!濺呀濺!

dialogue.en: Cheeky monkey! Now let's rinse it all off.
dialogue.zh: 馬騮精!而家沖乾淨佢。

dialogue.en: The floor is slippery — I'll be careful.
dialogue.zh: 地下好滑——我會小心。

dialogue.en: Good girl. Hold the rail when you step out.
dialogue.zh: 乖女。出嚟嗰陣揸實扶手。

dialogue.en: That was so much fun, I couldn't stop giggling!
dialogue.zh: 太好玩喇,我笑到停唔到!

dialogue.en: I've run you a lovely lukewarm bath — hop in, my little fish.
dialogue.zh: 我幫你放咗缸溫溫哋嘅水——跳入去啦,我條小魚仔。

dialogue.en: Ooh, it's just right! Not too hot, not too cold.
dialogue.zh: 嘩,啱啱好!唔太熱又唔太凍。

dialogue.en: Let me squeeze in some shampoo and work up a good lather.
dialogue.zh: 等我唧啲洗頭水,搓出啲豐富泡沫。

dialogue.en: My hair is all sudsy — I look like I've got a foam crown!
dialogue.zh: 我啲頭髮全部泡泡——好似戴咗頂泡沫皇冠咁!

dialogue.en: A royal foam crown indeed. Now tip your head back to rinse.
dialogue.zh: 真係一頂皇家泡沫皇冠。而家頭仰後沖乾淨。

dialogue.en: The warm water is running right down my back — it tickles!
dialogue.zh: 啲暖水沿住我個背脊流落嚟——好痕呀!

dialogue.en: Almost done. Let's scrub behind your ears where the dirt hides.
dialogue.zh: 就快搞掂。我哋擦下耳仔後面,污糟嘢匿埋喺嗰度。

dialogue.en: Now I'm completely drenched from head to toe!
dialogue.zh: 而家我由頭到腳濕晒!

dialogue.en: That means you're squeaky-clean. Ready to come out?
dialogue.zh: 即係你洗到乾乾淨淨喇。準備好出嚟未呀?

dialogue.en: Wait — can I pull the plug and watch the water swirl away?
dialogue.zh: 等陣——我可唔可以拔塞,睇住啲水打圈流走呀?

dialogue.en: Go on then. Careful, the bottom is slippery — hold the rail.
dialogue.zh: 咁你拔啦。小心,缸底好滑——揸實扶手。

dialogue.en: Brrr, I'm starting to shiver now that I'm out!
dialogue.zh: 凍呀,一出嚟我就開始打冷震喇!

dialogue.en: Quick, into this big fluffy towel — let me wrap you up snug.
dialogue.zh: 快啲,入呢條大鬆軟毛巾——等我包到你暖笠笠。

dialogue.en: Mmm, so warm and cozy, like a little burrito!
dialogue.zh: 嗯,好暖又好舒服,好似個小卷餅咁!

dialogue.en: There's my burrito baby, all clean and glistening.
dialogue.zh: 呢個就係我嘅卷餅寶寶,乾乾淨淨,閃閃發亮。

dialogue.en: I feel so fresh and refreshed — bath time is the best!
dialogue.zh: 我覺得好清爽好精神——沖涼最正喇!

dialogue.en: Time for a bath, you're all dirty!
dialogue.zh: 沖涼喇,你污糟晒喇!

dialogue.en: No bath! I want to run away!
dialogue.zh: 唔沖!我要走呀!

dialogue.en: Come back! I will catch you!
dialogue.zh: 返嚟!我捉到你㗎!

dialogue.en: Okay, but only if my toys come too.
dialogue.zh: 好啦,不過我啲玩具都要一齊。

dialogue.en: Sure! Your duck can splash with you.
dialogue.zh: 得!你隻鴨仔可以同你一齊濺水。

dialogue.en: Splash! This is fun after all!
dialogue.zh: 濺呀!原來都幾好玩喎!

dialogue.en: See? Bath time makes you laugh.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?沖涼令你笑。

dialogue.en: Now I'm clean and happy!
dialogue.zh: 而家我又乾淨又開心!

dialogue.en: Mama, I'm afraid of the loud drain!
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,我驚個去水位好大聲呀!

dialogue.en: Oh? What worries you about it?
dialogue.zh: 哦?你擔心佢啲乜嘢呀?

dialogue.en: It gurgles and I might go down it!
dialogue.zh: 佢咕嚕咕嚕聲,我怕會被吸落去!

dialogue.en: Let me explain — the hole is far too small for you.
dialogue.zh: 等我解釋——個窿細到你點都落唔到。

dialogue.en: Really? Are you sure I'm safe?
dialogue.zh: 真㗎?你肯定我安全㗎?

dialogue.en: I promise. Only the water can fit through.
dialogue.zh: 我保證。淨係啲水先鑽得過。

dialogue.en: So the gurgle is just the water leaving?
dialogue.zh: 咁咕嚕聲淨係啲水流走啫?

dialogue.en: Exactly! You understand it now.
dialogue.zh: 啱喇!你而家明白喇。

dialogue.en: Then I'll be brave and watch it drain.
dialogue.zh: 咁我勇敢啲睇住啲水流走。

dialogue.en: Good girl. Shall we wave goodbye to the water?
dialogue.zh: 乖女。我哋同啲水揮手講拜拜好唔好?

dialogue.en: Bye-bye water! Gurgle gurgle, all gone!
dialogue.zh: 拜拜水!咕嚕咕嚕,流晒喇!

dialogue.en: See? Nothing scary at all when you understand it.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?明白咗就一啲都唔得人驚。

dialogue.en: Not bath time again! I'm not getting in, and that's final!
dialogue.zh: 又話沖涼!我唔入去,冇得傾!

dialogue.en: Someone's kicking up a fuss tonight. What's really the matter?
dialogue.zh: 有人今晚發緊爛渣喎。究竟真係咩事呀?

dialogue.en: I just don't feel like it. Baths are boring and I hate the water.
dialogue.zh: 我就係唔想。沖涼好悶,我又憎啲水。

dialogue.en: Hmm, what if this isn't a boring bath, but a pirate's ocean voyage?
dialogue.zh: 嗯,如果呢個唔係悶沖涼,而係海盜嘅出海航程呢?

dialogue.en: A pirate voyage? Go on, I'm listening…
dialogue.zh: 海盜航程?講落去,我聽緊……

dialogue.en: You'd be the brave captain, and your duck is your loyal first mate.
dialogue.zh: 你做勇敢嘅船長,你隻鴨仔就係你忠心嘅大副。

dialogue.en: Ooh! And the bubbles could be giant ocean waves!
dialogue.zh: 哦!啲泡泡可以做巨大嘅海浪!

dialogue.en: Exactly. Climb aboard, Captain — your ship is ready to sail.
dialogue.zh: 啱喇。上船啦船長——你嘅船準備好開航。

dialogue.en: Aye aye! Full speed ahead through the foamy waves!
dialogue.zh: 遵命!全速前進,衝過啲泡沫巨浪!

dialogue.en: Careful of the whirlpool when I pull the plug at the end!
dialogue.zh: 最後我拔塞嗰陣,小心個漩渦呀!

dialogue.en: The water's spinning round and round — I'm totally mesmerised!
dialogue.zh: 啲水打圈圈咁轉——我睇到完全入迷!

dialogue.en: Now let's wash the sea salt off our brave captain's hair.
dialogue.zh: 而家我哋幫勇敢船長洗走頭髮上面嘅海鹽。

dialogue.en: This voyage turned out to be the best adventure ever!
dialogue.zh: 呢次航程原來係史上最正嘅冒險!

dialogue.en: See how a splash of imagination changed everything?
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?加少少想像力就完全唔同晒?

dialogue.en: Can tomorrow's bath be a mermaid palace instead?
dialogue.zh: 聽日沖涼可唔可以改做美人魚宮殿呀?

dialogue.en: A perfect plan, my little sailor. Now into your cozy towel.
dialogue.zh: 完美計劃,我個小水手。而家入返條暖笠笠嘅毛巾。

task.K3: 食生果時叫小朋友用英文講出每種生果嘅名同顏色(red apple、yellow banana),講啱就食一啖。
task.P1: 切生果時叫小朋友用英文形容味道(sweet、sour、juicy),練習描述口感。
task.P2: 去街市或超市揀生果,叫小朋友用英文形容 ripe、crunchy、tangy,練習描述細節同揀嘢。

dialogue.en: Would you like some fruit?
dialogue.zh: 你想唔想食啲生果呀?

dialogue.en: Yes! Can I have a red apple?
dialogue.zh: 想!我可以食個紅蘋果呀?

dialogue.en: Sure, let me wash it first.
dialogue.zh: 得,等我先洗乾淨佢。

dialogue.en: It looks so juicy and sweet!
dialogue.zh: 睇落好多汁好甜呀!

dialogue.en: Take a big bite!
dialogue.zh: 咬一大啖啦!

dialogue.en: Mmm! Can I have grapes too?
dialogue.zh: 嗯!我可以埋食提子呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, but eat them slowly.
dialogue.zh: 得,不過慢慢食。

dialogue.en: Fruit is my favourite snack!
dialogue.zh: 生果係我最鍾意嘅零食!

dialogue.en: Let's make a fruit bowl for a snack.
dialogue.zh: 我哋整碗生果做零食啦。

dialogue.en: Can I help peel the banana?
dialogue.zh: 我可以幫手剝香蕉皮呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, peel it from the top.
dialogue.zh: 得,由頂部開始剝。

dialogue.en: Done! What shall we slice next?
dialogue.zh: 搞掂!跟住切啲乜嘢呀?

dialogue.en: How about some sweet watermelon?
dialogue.zh: 切啲甜西瓜好唔好?

dialogue.en: Ooh, but watch out for the seeds!
dialogue.zh: 哦,不過小心啲籽呀!

dialogue.en: Good thinking. Try a strawberry too.
dialogue.zh: 諗得好。試埋粒士多啤梨。

dialogue.en: Eek, that one was a bit sour!
dialogue.zh: 咦,嗰粒有少少酸!

dialogue.en: Ha ha, the small ones can be like that.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈,細粒嗰啲會咁㗎。

dialogue.en: Fruit is healthy and tasty!
dialogue.zh: 生果又健康又好食!

dialogue.en: Shall we share the bowl with Papa?
dialogue.zh: 我哋同爸爸分享碗生果好唔好?

dialogue.en: Yes! Sharing makes it more fun.
dialogue.zh: 好!分享令佢更加好玩。

dialogue.en: Let's pick the ripest fruit from the market for our snack.
dialogue.zh: 我哋喺街市揀啲最熟嘅生果做零食啦。

dialogue.en: How do we know if a mango is ready to eat?
dialogue.zh: 點樣先知個芒果熟咗可以食呀?

dialogue.en: Give it a gentle squeeze — a ripe one feels soft and smells fragrant.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕哋揸下佢——熟嘅會軟軟哋,又香噴噴。

dialogue.en: This one smells amazing! Can we cut it right now?
dialogue.zh: 呢個好香呀!我哋可唔可以而家切呀?

dialogue.en: Let me slice it into little cubes so the juice doesn't dribble everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 等我切成細粒,咁啲汁就唔會滴到周圍都係。

dialogue.en: Mmm, it's so juicy the sweet juice is running down my chin!
dialogue.zh: 嗯,好多汁呀,啲甜汁流到落我下巴!

dialogue.en: Ha! Here's a napkin. Now try a slice of this crunchy green apple.
dialogue.zh: 哈!俾張紙巾你。而家試片爽脆嘅青蘋果。

dialogue.en: Wow, that one's really crunchy — and a little bit tangy too!
dialogue.zh: 嘩,呢片好爽脆——仲有少少酸酸地開胃!

dialogue.en: That tangy taste means it's full of vitamin C to keep you strong.
dialogue.zh: 嗰陣酸味即係含好多維他命C,令你身體強壯。

dialogue.en: Can we peel an orange and share the segments?
dialogue.zh: 我哋可唔可以剝個橙,分啲橙瓣嚟食呀?

dialogue.en: Of course. Careful — this side has a little bruise, so we'll cut it off.
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦。小心——呢邊有少少瘀,我哋切走佢。

dialogue.en: The segments look like little smiles all lined up in a circle!
dialogue.zh: 啲橙瓣好似一個個笑臉排成個圈咁!

dialogue.en: What a lovely way to see it. Fruit tastes best when it's fresh like this.
dialogue.zh: 形容得真好。生果新鮮就係咁樣至好食。

dialogue.en: This whole bowl is so refreshing — much better than sweets!
dialogue.zh: 成碗生果好清爽——好過食糖好多!

dialogue.en: I'm glad you think so. Let's nibble the rest while it's cold.
dialogue.zh: 你咁諗就好喇。趁啲生果凍,我哋慢慢細啖食晒佢。

dialogue.en: Rainbow fruit for a rainy day — this is the perfect snack!
dialogue.zh: 落雨天食彩虹生果——完美嘅零食!

dialogue.en: Here is a green kiwi for you.
dialogue.zh: 呢個綠色奇異果俾你。

dialogue.en: No! I don't like green fruit.
dialogue.zh: 唔要!我唔鍾意綠色生果。

dialogue.en: Just try one little taste.
dialogue.zh: 試一小啖啫。

dialogue.en: Hmm… okay, one tiny bite.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……好啦,咬一細啖。

dialogue.en: What a surprise! Do you like it?
dialogue.zh: 估唔到嘛!你鍾唔鍾意呀?

dialogue.en: It's so yummy and sweet!
dialogue.zh: 好好味又好甜呀!

dialogue.en: See? Trying new fruit is fun.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?試新生果好好玩。

dialogue.en: Can I have more, please?
dialogue.zh: 我可唔可以食多啲呀,唔該?

dialogue.en: You've only ever eaten apples. Why so picky?
dialogue.zh: 你淨係食蘋果。做咩咁揀飲擇食呀?

dialogue.en: Other fruits look strange to me.
dialogue.zh: 其他生果對我嚟講好奇怪。

dialogue.en: How about a fun rainbow challenge?
dialogue.zh: 不如玩個彩虹挑戰,好唔好玩呀?

dialogue.en: A rainbow challenge? What's that?
dialogue.zh: 彩虹挑戰?嗰啲係乜嘢嚟㗎?

dialogue.en: Try a fruit of every colour, one by one.
dialogue.zh: 逐一咁試每種顏色嘅生果。

dialogue.en: Okay! I'll be brave. Red first!
dialogue.zh: 好!我勇敢啲。先食紅色!

dialogue.en: Great! Now something orange and juicy.
dialogue.zh: 好嘢!而家試啲橙色又多汁嘅。

dialogue.en: This orange is delicious! Next, purple!
dialogue.zh: 呢個橙好美味!跟住,紫色!

dialogue.en: Grapes! You've almost made a whole rainbow.
dialogue.zh: 提子!你就快砌到成條彩虹喇。

dialogue.en: I tried five colours! I did the challenge!
dialogue.zh: 我試咗五種顏色!我完成咗挑戰!

dialogue.en: I'm so proud. Different fruits give you energy to grow.
dialogue.zh: 我好自豪。唔同生果俾你精力去成長。

dialogue.en: From now on, eating a rainbow will be my habit!
dialogue.zh: 由今日起,食彩虹會成為我嘅習慣!

dialogue.en: I bought a dragon fruit today — have you ever tried one?
dialogue.zh: 我今日買咗個火龍果——你食過未呀?

dialogue.en: Ew, it looks so weird with all those pink spikes!
dialogue.zh: 咦,好核突呀,成身粉紅色嘅刺!

dialogue.en: I know it looks unusual, but wait till you see inside.
dialogue.zh: 我知佢賣相特別,不過等你睇下入面先。

dialogue.en: Oh! It's white with tiny black seeds, like a starry sky!
dialogue.zh: 哦!入面白色仲有好多黑色細籽,好似星空咁!

dialogue.en: Exactly. Give it a little poke — feel how soft the texture is.
dialogue.zh: 啱喇。篤一篤佢——感受下個口感幾咁軟。

dialogue.en: Hmm, it feels a bit mushy… I'm not sure about this one.
dialogue.zh: 嗯,摸落有少少腍……我唔係咁肯定食唔食好。

dialogue.en: You don't have to love it. Just be adventurous and try one bite.
dialogue.zh: 你唔一定要鍾意佢。勇敢少少,試一啖啫。

dialogue.en: Okay, I'll stop hesitating… here goes nothing!
dialogue.zh: 好啦,我唔猶豫喇……豁出去喇!

dialogue.en: Well? Is it as scary as it looks?
dialogue.zh: 點呀?係咪好似個樣咁得人驚呀?

dialogue.en: Actually… it's pleasantly sweet and the seeds go crunch!
dialogue.zh: 其實……幾甜下喎,啲籽仲爽脆添!

dialogue.en: See? Sometimes the strangest-looking food is a delightful surprise.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?有時樣衰嘅食物反而係個驚喜。

dialogue.en: I was wrong to judge it by its spiky pink skin!
dialogue.zh: 我唔應該淨係睇佢啲粉紅色刺就話唔食!

dialogue.en: That's a wise lesson. Trying new things expands your world.
dialogue.zh: 呢個係個好聰明嘅道理。試新嘢會擴闊你嘅世界。

dialogue.en: Next time, let's find the strangest fruit in the whole market!
dialogue.zh: 下次我哋去搵成個街市最古怪嘅生果!

dialogue.en: It's a deal. My adventurous little food explorer!
dialogue.zh: 一言為定。我個勇於嘗試嘅小小美食探險家!

dialogue.en: From now on, I'll never say 'ew' before I taste it first!
dialogue.zh: 由今日起,我食之前都唔會再講『核突』喇!

task.K3: 喺公園玩時叫小朋友用英文講出玩緊嘅設施(slide、swing),玩一樣講一樣。
task.P1: 喺公園觀察大自然,叫小朋友用英文講出見到嘅嘢(bird、flower、butterfly),練習觀察詞彙。
task.P2: 喺公園同其他小朋友玩,叫小朋友用英文形容 take turns、cheer、out of breath,練習描述活動同社交。

dialogue.en: Look, we're at the park!
dialogue.zh: 你睇,我哋到咗公園喇!

dialogue.en: Yay! Can I go on the slide?
dialogue.zh: 好呀!我可以玩滑梯呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, hold on tight at the top.
dialogue.zh: 得,喺頂部揸實。

dialogue.en: Wheee! That was so fast!
dialogue.zh: 咻!好快呀!

dialogue.en: Do you want a push on the swing?
dialogue.zh: 要唔要我推你玩鞦韆呀?

dialogue.en: Yes! Push me high, please!
dialogue.zh: 要!推我高啲,唔該!

dialogue.en: Here you go — up you swing!
dialogue.zh: 嚟啦——盪高啲!

dialogue.en: I love the park! It's so much fun!
dialogue.zh: 我最鍾意公園!好好玩呀!

dialogue.en: What would you like to play first?
dialogue.zh: 你想先玩啲乜嘢呀?

dialogue.en: Can we go on the seesaw together?
dialogue.zh: 我哋可唔可以一齊玩蹺蹺板呀?

dialogue.en: Sure! Sit down and hold on tight.
dialogue.zh: 好!坐低揸實。

dialogue.en: Up and down, up and down!
dialogue.zh: 上下上下!

dialogue.en: Look, a butterfly landed on that flower!
dialogue.zh: 你睇,有隻蝴蝶停咗喺朵花度!

dialogue.en: It's so pretty! Can I chase it?
dialogue.zh: 好靚呀!我可唔可以追佢呀?

dialogue.en: Gently, don't scare it away.
dialogue.zh: 溫柔啲,唔好嚇走佢。

dialogue.en: Oh, it flew up to the tree.
dialogue.zh: 哦,佢飛咗上棵樹。

dialogue.en: Shall we climb the frame next?
dialogue.zh: 跟住我哋爬攀爬架好唔好?

dialogue.en: Yes, but I'll be careful at the top.
dialogue.zh: 好,不過我喺頂部會小心。

dialogue.en: Good girl. Let's rest on the bench after.
dialogue.zh: 乖女。玩完我哋喺長櫈度抖下。

dialogue.en: The park has so many things to do!
dialogue.zh: 公園有咁多嘢玩!

dialogue.en: What a glorious afternoon — feel that cool breeze on your face.
dialogue.zh: 幾咁好嘅下晝——感受下陣涼風吹面。

dialogue.en: The leaves are rustling in the wind — it sounds like the trees are whispering!
dialogue.zh: 啲樹葉喺風入面沙沙聲——好似棵樹喺度細聲講嘢咁!

dialogue.en: Beautifully said. Look, a squirrel just scampered up that trunk.
dialogue.zh: 形容得真美。你睇,有隻松鼠啱啱蹦蹦跳跳爬上樹幹。

dialogue.en: Can we fly my kite? There's just enough wind to make it soar!
dialogue.zh: 我哋可唔可以放風箏呀?啱啱夠風可以放到佢高飛!

dialogue.en: Perfect kite weather. Run along and let the string out slowly.
dialogue.zh: 好啱放風箏嘅天氣。跑住,慢慢放線。

dialogue.en: It's climbing higher and higher — all the way up past the treetops!
dialogue.zh: 佢越飛越高——一路升到過晒啲樹頂!

dialogue.en: Marvellous! Mind that muddy puddle from this morning's rain.
dialogue.zh: 好勁!小心嗰個朝早落雨整成嘅泥氹。

dialogue.en: Whoops, too late — I splashed right through it! My shoes are soaked.
dialogue.zh: 哎吔,遲喇——我一嘢踩咗落去!我對鞋濕晒。

dialogue.en: Cheeky thing! Come spin with me on the roundabout instead.
dialogue.zh: 馬騮精!過嚟同我一齊玩旋轉架啦。

dialogue.en: Round and round… ooh, I'm getting a bit dizzy now!
dialogue.zh: 轉呀轉……哦,我而家有少少頭暈喇!

dialogue.en: Let's stop before you get wobbly. You're out of breath already!
dialogue.zh: 停低先,咪整到你企唔穩。你已經氣喘吁吁喇!

dialogue.en: Can we just sprawl on the grass and watch the clouds for a while?
dialogue.zh: 我哋可唔可以攤喺草地度,睇下啲雲呀?

dialogue.en: What a lovely idea. That one looks just like a fluffy sheep, don't you think?
dialogue.zh: 好靚嘅主意。嗰舊雲好似隻毛毛綿羊,你話係咪?

dialogue.en: And that one's a dragon! I can hear the birds chirping too.
dialogue.zh: 嗰舊係條龍!我仲聽到啲雀仔啁啾添。

dialogue.en: Days like this make my heart feel so blissful and full.
dialogue.zh: 呢啲日子令我個心覺得好幸福好滿足。

dialogue.en: Can we come back to the park tomorrow, Mama? Please?
dialogue.zh: 聽日我哋可唔可以再嚟公園呀媽咪?求下你?

dialogue.en: The slide is too tall. I'm scared.
dialogue.zh: 個滑梯太高喇。我好驚。

dialogue.en: It's okay. I will hold your hand.
dialogue.zh: 唔緊要。我會揸住你隻手。

dialogue.en: What if I fall down?
dialogue.zh: 如果我跌親點算?

dialogue.en: You won't. Just try one time.
dialogue.zh: 唔會㗎。試一次啫。

dialogue.en: Okay… here I go!
dialogue.zh: 好啦……我落嚟喇!

dialogue.en: You did it! You were so brave!
dialogue.zh: 你做到喇!你好勇敢!

dialogue.en: That was fun! Can I go again?
dialogue.zh: 好好玩呀!我可以再玩呀?

dialogue.en: Yes! I'm so proud of you.
dialogue.zh: 得!我為你感到好自豪。

dialogue.en: Mama, everyone is playing but me. I feel lonely.
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,個個都喺度玩,得我一個。我覺得好孤單。

dialogue.en: Why don't you go and join them?
dialogue.zh: 點解你唔去加入佢哋呀?

dialogue.en: I'm too shy to say hello.
dialogue.zh: 我太怕醜,唔敢打招呼。

dialogue.en: A friendly smile is a good way to start.
dialogue.zh: 一個友善嘅笑容係個好開始。

dialogue.en: What if they don't want to play with me?
dialogue.zh: 如果佢哋唔想同我玩呢?

dialogue.en: Just ask kindly, 'Can I play too?'
dialogue.zh: 禮貌咁問:『我可唔可以一齊玩呀?』

dialogue.en: Okay… I'll be brave and try.
dialogue.zh: 好啦……我勇敢啲試下。

dialogue.en: Go on, I'll be right here watching.
dialogue.zh: 去啦,我喺呢度睇住你。

dialogue.en: Hi! Can I play with you?
dialogue.zh: 你好!我可唔可以同你哋一齊玩呀?

dialogue.en: Look, they're waving you over!
dialogue.zh: 你睇,佢哋揮手叫你過去呀!

dialogue.en: They said welcome! Now we're all laughing together!
dialogue.zh: 佢哋話歡迎我!而家我哋一齊笑!

dialogue.en: See? Making friends just takes a little courage.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?識朋友只係需要少少勇氣。

dialogue.en: Oh no, it's suddenly pouring! Our park day is ruined.
dialogue.zh: 哎吔,突然間傾盆大雨!我哋嘅公園日泡湯喇。

dialogue.en: Don't be too disappointed — quick, let's dash to that pavilion for shelter.
dialogue.zh: 唔好咁失望——快啲,我哋衝去嗰個涼亭避雨。

dialogue.en: We made it! But now we're stuck here with nothing to do.
dialogue.zh: 到喇!不過而家困喺度,冇嘢做。

dialogue.en: Says who? Listen to the rain drumming on the roof — isn't it soothing?
dialogue.zh: 邊個話冇?你聽下啲雨打喺個頂,係咪好舒服呀?

dialogue.en: It does sound nice… and it smells so fresh and earthy now.
dialogue.zh: 真係幾好聽……而家啲空氣好清新,有陣泥土味。

dialogue.en: That lovely smell after rain even has a name — it's called petrichor.
dialogue.zh: 雨後嗰陣香味仲有個名添——叫做『雨後泥土香』。

dialogue.en: Petrichor! Ooh, look, the heavy rain is easing into a light drizzle.
dialogue.zh: 雨後泥土香!哦你睇,大雨開始變返毛毛雨喇。

dialogue.en: Perfect. Shall we go and splash in the puddles while it's gentle?
dialogue.zh: 好極。趁雨細,我哋去啲水氹度濺水好唔好?

dialogue.en: Yes! Stomp, stomp — look at the water splashing everywhere!
dialogue.zh: 好!踩、踩——你睇啲水濺到周圍都係!

dialogue.en: Your wellies were a wise choice today, weren't they?
dialogue.zh: 你今日著咗水鞋真係好聰明,係咪?

dialogue.en: Mama, look up! There's a huge rainbow across the whole sky!
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,望上去!成個天空有條好大嘅彩虹呀!

dialogue.en: How breathtaking — and everything is glistening after the rain.
dialogue.zh: 真係好靚——雨後所有嘢都閃閃發亮。

dialogue.en: This turned out even better than a sunny day!
dialogue.zh: 呢日結果仲好過晴天添!

dialogue.en: You see? A change of plans can become an unexpected adventure.
dialogue.zh: 睇到未?計劃改變都可以變成意想不到嘅冒險。

dialogue.en: A rainy park day is now my most memorable one ever!
dialogue.zh: 落雨嘅公園日而家係我最難忘嘅一日!

dialogue.en: That's the spirit, my cheerful girl. Let's chase that rainbow home.
dialogue.zh: 呢個先啱,我個開朗嘅乖女。我哋追住條彩虹返屋企啦。

task.K3: 睇書時叫小朋友用英文講出圖畫入面見到嘅嘢(cat、house、sun),指一樣講一樣。
task.P1: 睇故事書時停低問「What happens next?」,鼓勵小朋友用英文估下劇情,練習表達諗法。
task.P2: 睇完故事叫小朋友用英文講返個故仔,形容 character、brave、lesson,練習複述同表達感受。

dialogue.en: Shall we read a story together?
dialogue.zh: 我哋一齊睇個故事好唔好?

dialogue.en: Yes! Can I pick the book?
dialogue.zh: 好!我可以揀本書呀?

dialogue.en: Of course. Let's turn the first page.
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦。我哋揭第一版。

dialogue.en: Look, a cat in the picture!
dialogue.zh: 你睇,圖畫入面有隻貓!

dialogue.en: What colour is the cat?
dialogue.zh: 隻貓咩顏色呀?

dialogue.en: It's orange! What happens next?
dialogue.zh: 佢橙色!跟住點呀?

dialogue.en: Let's turn the page and see.
dialogue.zh: 我哋揭版睇下。

dialogue.en: I love reading with you, Mama!
dialogue.zh: 我最鍾意同你睇書媽咪!

dialogue.en: Look at the cover — what do you think this story is about?
dialogue.zh: 睇下封面——你估呢個故事講咩呀?

dialogue.en: I see a dragon! Maybe it's about a brave knight.
dialogue.zh: 我見到條龍!可能講一個勇敢騎士。

dialogue.en: Good guess! Let's read the title together.
dialogue.zh: 估得好!我哋一齊讀書名。

dialogue.en: 'The Dragon Who Couldn't Fly.' How sad!
dialogue.zh: 《唔識飛嘅龍》。好慘呀!

dialogue.en: Why do you think he can't fly?
dialogue.zh: 你估佢點解唔識飛呀?

dialogue.en: Maybe his wings are too small?
dialogue.zh: 可能佢對翼太細?

dialogue.en: Let's find out. Turn to the next chapter.
dialogue.zh: 睇下係唔係。揭去下一章。

dialogue.en: Ooh, he's trying to jump off a hill!
dialogue.zh: 哦,佢試緊喺山上面跳落嚟!

dialogue.en: What do you think will happen?
dialogue.zh: 你估會發生咩事呀?

dialogue.en: I imagine he'll finally learn to fly!
dialogue.zh: 我估佢最後會學識飛!

dialogue.en: Let's see if you're right at the ending.
dialogue.zh: 睇下你估唔估中個結局。

dialogue.en: This is my favourite story now!
dialogue.zh: 呢個而家係我最鍾意嘅故事!

dialogue.en: This looks like a thrilling adventure — the illustrations are so vivid!
dialogue.zh: 呢本好似係一個緊張刺激嘅冒險——啲插圖好生動!

dialogue.en: The forest on this page looks so real, I feel like I could step right in!
dialogue.zh: 呢版嘅森林好似真㗎咁,我覺得可以行入去添!

dialogue.en: That's the magic of a good book. Now, who do you think this cloaked figure is?
dialogue.zh: 呢個就係好書嘅魔力。你估呢個披住斗篷嘅人係邊個呀?

dialogue.en: Ooh, I bet he's the sneaky villain hiding in the shadows!
dialogue.zh: 哦,我夠膽講佢係匿埋喺陰影度嘅奸角!

dialogue.en: You might be right. The plot is really thickening now, isn't it?
dialogue.zh: 你可能估啱。個情節而家越嚟越緊張,係咪?

dialogue.en: The suspense is unbearable — I have to know what's behind that door!
dialogue.zh: 個懸念真係頂唔順——我一定要知度門後面有咩!

dialogue.en: Shall I read the next part in a spooky whisper?
dialogue.zh: 不如我用陰森嘅細聲讀下一段?

dialogue.en: Yes! That makes it even more exciting and creepy!
dialogue.zh: 好!咁樣仲刺激仲得人驚!

dialogue.en: Oh! What a twist — the villain was actually trying to help all along!
dialogue.zh: 哦!好大轉折——原來個奸角一直都想幫手!

dialogue.en: I never saw that coming! I was completely fooled.
dialogue.zh: 我完全估唔到!俾佢呃晒。

dialogue.en: The best stories always surprise us. And look, the chapter ends on a cliffhanger.
dialogue.zh: 最好嘅故事總會出人意表。你睇,呢一章喺扣人心弦嘅位收尾。

dialogue.en: No fair! It stopped right at the most exciting bit!
dialogue.zh: 唔公平!喺最刺激嗰度停低!

dialogue.en: That's how they keep us reading. What do you think the moral of the story is?
dialogue.zh: 佢哋就係咁樣吸住我哋睇落去。你覺得呢個故事嘅寓意係咩呀?

dialogue.en: Maybe it's that we shouldn't judge someone before we really know them.
dialogue.zh: 可能係唔應該喺未真正了解一個人之前就評論佢。

dialogue.en: What a thoughtful lesson to take away. Shall we read one more chapter?
dialogue.zh: 真係一個好有深度嘅道理。我哋再睇多一章好唔好?

dialogue.en: Just one more, please — this book is absolutely enchanting!
dialogue.zh: 再多一章啫,唔該——呢本書真係太引人入勝喇!

dialogue.en: One more story, please, Mama!
dialogue.zh: 再講一個故事啦,媽咪!

dialogue.en: But it's late and you look tired.
dialogue.zh: 但係好夜喇,你又好攰。

dialogue.en: I'm not tired! Just one more.
dialogue.zh: 我唔攰!再一個啫。

dialogue.en: Okay, one short story about the moon.
dialogue.zh: 好啦,一個關於月亮嘅短故事。

dialogue.en: The moon is so quiet and bright.
dialogue.zh: 月亮又靜又光。

dialogue.en: Now close your eyes for a big hug.
dialogue.zh: 而家閉埋眼,俾個大擁抱你。

dialogue.en: Good night. I'll dream about the moon.
dialogue.zh: 晚安。我會夢見月亮。

dialogue.en: Sweet dreams, my darling.
dialogue.zh: 發個好夢,我嘅寶貝。

dialogue.en: This word is too difficult. I want to give up.
dialogue.zh: 呢個字太難喇。我想放棄。

dialogue.en: Don't give up. Let's sound it out slowly.
dialogue.zh: 唔好放棄。我哋慢慢拼讀。

dialogue.en: But I've never seen this word before.
dialogue.zh: 但係我未見過呢個字。

dialogue.en: Try the first letter — what sound does it make?
dialogue.zh: 試下第一個字母——佢發咩音呀?

dialogue.en: 'B'… buh… butter… butterfly?
Yes! You read it all by yourself!
dialogue.zh: 啱!你自己讀到喇!

dialogue.en: I did? I really read it myself!
dialogue.zh: 係咩?我真係自己讀到!

dialogue.en: With a little patience, you can do it.
dialogue.zh: 有少少耐性,你就做得到。

dialogue.en: Can I try the next hard word too?
dialogue.zh: 我可唔可以試埋下一個難字呀?

dialogue.en: That's the spirit! I'm so proud of you.
dialogue.zh: 呢個先啱!我為你感到好自豪。

dialogue.en: Reading gives me so much confidence now!
dialogue.zh: 睇書而家俾咗好多自信我!

dialogue.en: You achieved that all on your own.
dialogue.zh: 你完全靠自己做到㗎。

dialogue.en: You've been glued to your tablet all day. Why not try a real book?
dialogue.zh: 你成日黐住個平板電腦。點解唔試下睇本真書呀?

dialogue.en: Books are boring — they don't have any bright screens or sounds.
dialogue.zh: 書好悶——冇光鮮嘅螢幕又冇聲。

dialogue.en: Is that so? I found this dusty old one in the attic — it looks mysterious.
dialogue.zh: 係咩?我喺閣樓搵到本佈滿塵嘅舊書——睇落好神秘。

dialogue.en: Hmm, the cover does look like it's hiding some kind of secret…
dialogue.zh: 嗯,個封面睇落好似收埋咗啲秘密咁……

dialogue.en: Shall we open it and see what treasure lies inside?
dialogue.zh: 不如我哋揭開睇下入面有咩寶藏?

dialogue.en: Okay, I'm a little curious now. Oh! The illustrations are gorgeous!
dialogue.zh: 好啦,我而家有少少好奇。哦!啲插圖好靚呀!

dialogue.en: Look, it's a map to a hidden island. Where do you think it leads?
dialogue.zh: 你睇,係一幅通去神秘島嘅地圖。你估通去邊呀?

dialogue.en: Maybe to a cave full of glittering gold and sleeping dragons!
dialogue.zh: 可能通去一個裝滿閃令令黃金同瞓緊嘅龍嘅山洞!

dialogue.en: Only one way to find out — shall I read the first chapter aloud?
dialogue.zh: 得一個方法知道——不如我大聲讀第一章?

dialogue.en: Yes, please! I want to know if the dragons are friendly or fierce.
dialogue.zh: 好呀,唔該!我想知啲龍係友善定係兇猛。

dialogue.en: An hour has flown by and you haven't looked up once, my little bookworm.
dialogue.zh: 一個鐘咁快就過咗,你連頭都冇抬過,我個小書蟲。

dialogue.en: I got so engrossed I completely forgot about the tablet!
dialogue.zh: 我睇到太投入,完全唔記得個平板電腦!

dialogue.en: That's the magic of reading — a good book transports you anywhere.
dialogue.zh: 呢個就係睇書嘅魔力——一本好書可以帶你去任何地方。

dialogue.en: I feel like I actually sailed to that island with the characters!
dialogue.zh: 我覺得我真係同啲角色一齊揚帆去咗嗰個島!

dialogue.en: Books can be the most treasured companions, opening up whole new worlds.
dialogue.zh: 書可以係最珍貴嘅同伴,為你打開一個個新世界。

dialogue.en: Can this be our special book that we read together every night?
dialogue.zh: 呢本可唔可以做我哋每晚一齊睇嘅特別書呀?

task.K3: 瞓覺前叫小朋友用英文講出瞓覺嘅步驟(pyjamas、light off、good night),做一樣講一樣。
task.P1: 熄燈前傾下今日,叫小朋友用英文講出今日開心嘅一件事,練習分享感受。
task.P2: 瞓覺前做感恩練習,叫小朋友用英文形容 cozy、drift off、grateful,講出三件感恩嘅事。

dialogue.en: Time for bed! Put on your pyjamas.
dialogue.zh: 瞓覺喇!著返睡衣。

dialogue.en: Okay, Mama. I'm all cozy now.
dialogue.zh: 好呀媽咪。我而家暖笠笠喇。

dialogue.en: Lie down on your pillow.
dialogue.zh: 瞓落個枕頭度。

dialogue.en: Can you tuck in my blanket?
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以幫我冚好張被呀?

dialogue.en: Of course. Shall I turn off the light?
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦。我熄燈好唔好呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, please. Good night, Mama.
dialogue.zh: 好呀,唔該。晚安媽咪。

dialogue.en: Good night. Here's a kiss.
dialogue.zh: 晚安。錫一啖。

dialogue.en: I love you. See you in the morning!
dialogue.zh: 我愛你。朝早見!

dialogue.en: Did you brush your teeth before bed?
dialogue.zh: 你瞓覺前刷咗牙未呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, all done. Can I keep the nightlight on?
dialogue.zh: 刷咗喇。個小夜燈可唔可以開住呀?

dialogue.en: Of course, it will glow softly all night.
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦,佢會成晚柔和咁光。

dialogue.en: Where's my teddy? I want to cuddle him.
dialogue.zh: 我隻熊仔喺邊?我想攬實佢。

dialogue.en: Here he is, right beside you.
dialogue.zh: 佢喺度,喺你隔籬。

dialogue.en: I'm getting so sleepy… *yawn*
dialogue.zh: 我好眼瞓喇……*打喊露*

dialogue.en: Let me tuck you in nice and snug.
dialogue.zh: 等我幫你冚到暖笠笠。

dialogue.en: Can you whisper a little song?
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以細聲唱首歌呀?

dialogue.en: Of course, close your eyes and listen.
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦,閉埋眼聽啦。

dialogue.en: I hope I have happy dreams tonight.
dialogue.zh: 希望我今晚發個開心嘅夢。

dialogue.en: You will. Sweet dreams, my darling.
dialogue.zh: 你會㗎。發個好夢,我嘅寶貝。

dialogue.en: Good night, Mama. See you in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 晚安媽咪。朝早見。

dialogue.en: There you are, all snug as a bug under your warm blanket.
dialogue.zh: 好喇,你喺暖笠笠嘅被入面,舒服到好似隻小蟲仔咁。

dialogue.en: The moonlight is peeking through the curtains — it's so pretty.
dialogue.zh: 月光由窗簾罅度射入嚟——好靚呀。

dialogue.en: It's like the moon is watching over you while you sleep.
dialogue.zh: 好似月亮喺度守護住瞓緊覺嘅你咁。

dialogue.en: Mama, why do the shadows look so big and wobbly on the wall?
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,點解啲影喺牆上面咁大又郁嚟郁去嘅?

dialogue.en: That's just your nightlight dancing with the tree outside — nothing scary.
dialogue.zh: 嗰啲淨係你個小夜燈同出面棵樹跳緊舞啫——冇乜好驚。

dialogue.en: Oh, now they look like little bunnies hopping about!
dialogue.zh: 哦,而家佢哋好似啲兔仔跳嚟跳去咁!

dialogue.en: What a lovely way to see them. Now close those sleepy eyes.
dialogue.zh: 形容得真得意。而家閉埋你對眼瞓嘅眼。

dialogue.en: Can you hum my favourite lullaby? It always helps me drift off.
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以哼我最鍾意嗰首催眠曲呀?佢成日幫我慢慢瞓着。

dialogue.en: Of course, my love. Just let the soft tune carry you away.
dialogue.zh: 梗係得啦,我嘅寶貝。俾嗰首柔和嘅曲仔帶你走啦。

dialogue.en: My eyelids are getting so heavy… I can barely keep them open.
dialogue.zh: 我對眼皮好重……我幾乎撐唔開喇。

dialogue.en: That's alright, just let them flutter shut. I'm right here.
dialogue.zh: 冇問題,俾佢哋慢慢眨埋啦。我喺度陪住你。

dialogue.en: The room feels so peaceful and quiet now… *yawn*
dialogue.zh: 間房而家好寧靜好靜……*打喊露*

dialogue.en: Sleep tight, my darling. I'll leave the door open just a crack.
dialogue.zh: 瞓得好啲,我嘅寶貝。我會將度門留返條罅。

dialogue.en: Stay with me until I fall asleep… please, Mama?
dialogue.zh: 陪住我直到我瞓着……好唔好呀,媽咪?

dialogue.en: Always. I'll be right beside you, humming softly in the dark.
dialogue.zh: 梗係啦。我會喺你身邊,喺黑暗入面輕輕哋哼歌。

dialogue.en: Good night… I love you… to the moon and back…
dialogue.zh: 晚安……我愛你……去到月球再返嚟咁多……

dialogue.en: Mama, it's too dark. I'm scared!
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,太黑喇。我好驚!

dialogue.en: What are you scared of, my dear?
dialogue.zh: 你驚啲乜嘢呀,乖女?

dialogue.en: Maybe there's a monster under my bed!
dialogue.zh: 可能我張床下面有隻怪獸!

dialogue.en: Let's look together. See? Nothing there.
dialogue.zh: 我哋一齊睇下。睇到未?乜都冇。

dialogue.en: Can I have my nightlight on?
dialogue.zh: 可唔可以開我個小夜燈呀?

dialogue.en: Yes, now the room is not so dark.
dialogue.zh: 得,而家間房冇咁黑喇。

dialogue.en: And teddy will keep me safe!
dialogue.zh: 仲有熊仔會保護我!

dialogue.en: That's right. Now sleep, my brave girl.
dialogue.zh: 啱喇。而家瞓啦,我個勇敢嘅乖女。

dialogue.en: Mama, I can't sleep. I'm too excited about tomorrow!
dialogue.zh: 媽咪,我瞓唔着。我對聽日太興奮喇!

dialogue.en: I know the trip is exciting, but your body needs rest.
dialogue.zh: 我知個旅行好興奮,但係你個身體需要休息。

dialogue.en: But I keep wriggling. I feel so restless!
dialogue.zh: 但係我一直郁嚟郁去。我好坐立不安!

dialogue.en: Let's try counting sheep together, shall we?
dialogue.zh: 我哋一齊數綿羊好唔好?

dialogue.en: One sheep… two sheep… three sheep…
dialogue.zh: 一隻羊……兩隻羊……三隻羊……

dialogue.en: Good. Now breathe in slowly, then out slowly.
dialogue.zh: 好。而家慢慢吸氣,再慢慢呼氣。

dialogue.en: In… and out… I feel calmer now.
dialogue.zh: 吸……呼……我而家平靜咗喇。

dialogue.en: See how your body is starting to relax?
dialogue.zh: 你有冇留意到你個身體開始放鬆?

dialogue.en: My eyes feel heavy now… *yawn*
dialogue.zh: 我對眼而家好重……*打喊露*

dialogue.en: That's it. Let them close all by themselves.
dialogue.zh: 係咁喇。俾佢哋自己慢慢閉埋。

dialogue.en: Good night, Mama… tomorrow will be fun…
dialogue.zh: 晚安媽咪……聽日會好好玩……

dialogue.en: Sweet dreams. You'll be fast asleep in no time.
dialogue.zh: 發個好夢。你好快就瞓着㗎喇。

dialogue.en: Mama! I had a horrible nightmare — I'm trembling all over!
dialogue.zh: 媽咪!我發咗個好恐怖嘅惡夢——我成身震晒!

dialogue.en: Oh my poor darling, come here into my arms. You're safe now.
dialogue.zh: 哎呀我嘅寶貝,過嚟我度俾我攬住。你而家安全喇。

dialogue.en: There was a huge dark shadow chasing me and I couldn't run away!
dialogue.zh: 有個好大嘅黑影追住我,我又走唔甩!

dialogue.en: It felt so real, didn't it? But dreams can't hurt you, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 感覺好真係咪?但係夢係傷害唔到你㗎,我保證。

dialogue.en: But what if I close my eyes and it comes right back?
dialogue.zh: 但係如果我閉埋眼佢又返嚟點算?

dialogue.en: Let's chase it away by imagining something warm and happy instead.
dialogue.zh: 我哋想像啲暖笠笠又開心嘅嘢,將個惡夢趕走啦。

dialogue.en: Like what, Mama? I can't think of anything nice right now.
dialogue.zh: 例如咩呀媽咪?我而家諗唔到任何開心嘅嘢。

dialogue.en: Picture a cozy beach, golden sand, and gentle waves whispering hello.
dialogue.zh: 想像一個舒適嘅沙灘,金黃色嘅沙,同啲溫柔嘅海浪同你講你好。

dialogue.en: Ooh… and maybe a friendly dolphin doing flips in the sunshine?
dialogue.zh: 哦……可能仲有隻友善嘅海豚喺陽光下面翻筋斗?

dialogue.en: Exactly. Now let's think of three things we're grateful for today.
dialogue.zh: 啱喇。而家我哋諗下今日三件值得感恩嘅事。

dialogue.en: Um… our fun day at the park, my yummy dinner, and cuddles with you.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……我哋喺公園開心嘅一日、我美味嘅晚飯、同埋同你攬攬。

dialogue.en: What lovely things to be grateful for. Feel a bit calmer now?
dialogue.zh: 幾咁美好嘅事值得感恩。而家平靜返少少未呀?

dialogue.en: Yes… my heart isn't racing anymore, and I feel warm and safe.
dialogue.zh: 係……我個心冇再跳咁快喇,我覺得暖笠笠又安全。

dialogue.en: Good. Let those happy thoughts gently carry you back to sleep.
dialogue.zh: 好。俾嗰啲開心嘅諗法慢慢帶你返去瞓覺啦。

dialogue.en: Will you stay a little longer, just until I drift off?
dialogue.zh: 你可唔可以再陪耐少少,直到我瞓着呀?

dialogue.en: I'm not going anywhere. Sleep peacefully, my cherished little one.
dialogue.zh: 我唔會走㗎。安詳咁瞓啦,我珍愛嘅寶貝。
